prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Keep this same realistic raw gray-green shrimp with its shell details, pose, colors, full legs and tail, lighting and warm ivory background. Reframe the whole subject slightly smaller, occupying at most 80 percent of the square canvas width, so ALL antennae and fine feeler tips are completely inside the image with at least 8 percent clear margin on every side. Restore the fine feeler that exits the left edge, letting it curve naturally inward and end visibly. Nothing touches or crosses the frame. Preserve realism and anatomy. No extra shrimp, props, text or border.
original_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE square realistic shrimp portrait for a children's Bengali-English picture dictionary. Subject: one whole living-looking uncooked shrimp (chingri), with a naturally translucent pale gray-green segmented shell, subtle muted brown bands, darker gray dorsal shading, glossy small black eyes on short stalks, a pointed serrated rostrum, two long fine curved antennae, delicate jointed walking legs beneath the thorax, small swimmerets beneath the abdomen, and a clearly spread natural tail fan. Natural gently curved elongated body in a clear side three-quarter view, head toward left and tail to right, believable shrimp anatomy and correct appendage attachment, no giant lobster claws. Fine realistic shell detail, natural organic proportions, subtle moist sheen without plastic shine. It must look like fresh raw shrimp, NOT a bright red or orange cooked shrimp, not peeled, not lobster, not cartoon. Plain warm ivory seamless background with soft diffuse daylight and a gentle contact shadow. Entire shrimp including all antenna tips, legs, rostrum and tail inside the square with comfortable margins; arrange long antennae in natural gentle curves within the frame. Main body large and readable at mobile thumbnail size. No water scenery, plate, food garnish, hooks, hands, blood, extra animals, text, labels, border or watermark.
